boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten distinct MCCN spaces documented by college sources for studying, practicing nursing skills, connecting, living, and gathering.

cards.title: Practice in the Center for Innovative Learning
cards.subtitle: 777 West State Street, Suite 400
cards.notes: Arrange a faculty-supervised simulation session here to rehearse interventions with lifelike patient simulators before clinical work.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative clinical-simulation facility where MCCN students train individually and in care teams.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that students train individually or in care teams using high-fidelity patient simulators under faculty supervision.
cards.access_notes: Located adjacent to the college; use is for MCCN and Mount Carmel training participants.

cards.title: Settle into the Health Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education
cards.notes: Use the two-story library for a focused study block, then ask library staff for help locating nursing and health-science resources.
cards.short_summary: MCCN’s health-science library is part of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN identifies the Health Sciences Library as a professional academic resource and says the Center for Learning and Education includes a two-story health-science library.
cards.access_notes: Check with MCCN or library staff for current access arrangements.

cards.title: Take a break in the Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Main campus, lower level
cards.notes: Meet classmates between classes to study, watch television, play games, or purchase a snack in the lower-level recreation center.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level student space for informal connection, studying, games, television, and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN says its lower-level student recreation center lets students connect, study, purchase snacks, watch television, and play games.
cards.access_notes: Located in the main campus building; confirm current student access with Student Life.

cards.title: Use the Student Lounge for peer encouragement
cards.subtitle: Main campus building
cards.notes: Choose the lounge for a short check-in with classmates or a reset between coursework; keep conversation mindful of others using the space.
cards.short_summary: An MCCN alumni account recalls students supporting and encouraging one another in the lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: An MCCN alumnus described the student lounge as a place where students supported and encouraged each other.
cards.source_title: 10 Questions with LaKesha Wyse, DNP, RN ’03
cards.access_notes: MCCN lists a lounge in its main campus building; confirm current availability on arrival.

cards.entity_name: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Chapel
cards.title: Pause in the restored Student Chapel
cards.subtitle: MCCN Franklinton campus
cards.notes: Use this all-faiths chapel for quiet reflection before or after a demanding day; respect any posted worship or reserved-use notices.
cards.short_summary: The restored chapel is available to MCCN students, faculty, and staff of all faiths.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN reports that the restored School of Nursing chapel is available for students, faculty, and staff of all faiths.
cards.access_notes: Available to MCCN students, faculty, and staff; observe posted schedules and faith-space etiquette.

cards.title: Meet at the Center for Learning and Education
cards.subtitle: MCCN main campus
cards.notes: Use its library, computer lab, learning labs, meeting rooms, and auditorium as your planned base for campus academic work.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic hub with library, computer, learning, meeting, classroom, and auditorium spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN says the Center for Learning and Education includes a two-story health-science library, computer laboratory, learning labs, meeting rooms, classrooms, and auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Campus academic facility; verify room availability and access with the college.

cards.entity_name: Mount Carmel Medical Staff Building Auditorium
cards.title: Find the Medical Staff Building Auditorium
cards.subtitle: MCCN campus
cards.notes: Use the auditorium as a landmark for college ceremonies and major gatherings, and check event instructions before entering or reserving seats.
cards.short_summary: The campus auditorium has hosted MCCN convocation, commissioning, pinning, and graduation events.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN identifies the Medical Staff Building Auditorium as an MCCN-campus venue for convocation and other college ceremonies.
cards.source_title: MCCN Convocation Ceremony to Celebrate the Start of the 2018–19 Academic Year
cards.access_notes: Event venue; attend when an MCCN event is scheduled or access is authorized.

cards.title: Use Angela Hall’s shared resident amenities
cards.subtitle: MCCN apartment-style residence hall
cards.notes: Resident students can plan a low-key group session around the community, yoga, exercise, recreation, and study-lounge amenities here.
cards.short_summary: One of MCCN’s apartment-style residences, with several documented shared resident amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s housing material lists the Community Room, Yoga Room, Exercise Room, Rec Room, and Study Lounge in Angela Hall.
cards.access_notes: Amenities are described for MCCN student residents; confirm current residence access with Student Life.

cards.title: Gather in Holy Cross Hall’s Group Study Area
cards.subtitle: MCCN apartment-style residence hall
cards.notes: Resident students can use the named computer room and group study area to compare notes, prepare assignments, and study together.
cards.short_summary: An MCCN residence hall with a documented computer room and group study area for residents.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s housing material identifies a Computer Room/Group Study Area in Holy Cross Hall.
cards.access_notes: The group study area is described as a nearby amenity for MCCN housing residents; confirm current access.

cards.title: Orient yourself in the Main Campus Building
cards.subtitle: 127 South Davis Avenue, Columbus
cards.notes: Use the main building as a practical meet-up point before class; it houses classrooms, faculty and staff offices, a lounge, and gymnasium.
cards.short_summary: MCCN’s principal campus building brings together classes, offices, a lounge, and a gymnasium stage.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that its main campus building houses classrooms, staff and faculty offices, a lounge, and a gymnasium with a performance stage.
cards.access_notes: Main campus address is 127 South Davis Avenue; follow visitor and building-access guidance.
